messages:
marie: heads-up — i'm opening a docs PR for the private/on-prem migration guide. main goal: add a minimal privileged service-account example, clarify HSM KMS flow during migration, and give an SDK proxy-chaining snippet for sealed/airgapped installs. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9876 :wave:
chen: thanks marie — can you call out which auth scopes the installer needs? previous threads got messy w/ overly-broad service roles.
olivia: +1 on minimum-privileges. for HSM we need to show the pkcs11 user mapping and example `p11tool` commands. any sample creds should be fake.
tanay: also maybe add a short troubleshooting bullet about failures when the proxy does port mapping (we saw 443->8443 NAT in customer envs). small note: env var name is `REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN` not `REDFLOW_PROXY` in the SDK.
marie: good catch tanay. i'll update the SDK snippet. planning to include this snippet in the doc: ```bash
# example proxy-chaining for SDK (node)
export REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN="http://proxy1.local:3128,http://eproxy:8080"
node -e "require('redwood-sdk').connect()"
```
chen: can we also show a curl fallback for quick debugging? something like: `curl -x http://proxy1:3128 -v https://kms.internal.local/health`
marie: yeah will add that. question for docs-bot: can we auto-generate an include for the installer YAML partial from the repo so examples don't drift?
docs-bot: @marie — proposing to use the `include_snippet` action from our docs CI. see https://docs.redwood.ai/dev/ci-snippets. It requires snippet files under `docs/snippets/` and a small meta header. :robot_face:
olivia: for HSM rotation section, add an explicit step that the pkcs11 slot pin is never stored in the installer bundle; recommend using an operator prompt or KMS-backed secret provider. give an example CLI flow for interactive pin entry.
marie: wrote an interactive example, will paste in PR. also added a short note: "if using opaque network overlays (weave/consul), ensure MTU >= 1400 or KV cache streaming may stall". can someone sanity-check that wording?
chen: MTU wording lgtm, maybe change to "recommended MTU >= 1400 for stable token streams". shorter and prescriptive.
tanay: small nit — in the SDK snippet please include the node example that demonstrates `REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN` being parsed into requests so it's copy-pasteable. also add a python sample.
marie: adding python example: ```py
import os
from redwood_sdk import Client
os.environ['REDFLOW_PROXY_CHAIN'] = 'http://proxy1:3128;http://eproxy:8080'
client = Client()
print(client.health.check())
```
olivia: pls use commas in the python example to match the parser, we standardized on comma delim.
marie: fixed. updated PR with new snippets, ATTN @chen @tanay @olivia for review. link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9876
chen: reviewing now, will push a small commit to tighten the HSM CLI examples.
tanay: i ran the node snippet locally — works but the SDK logs a `proxy-chaining: fallback to direct` on first attempt which is expected; maybe add a note explaining that the SDK probes endpoints in order.
marie: added a short paragraph explaining probe/fallback behavior and how to set `REDFLOW_PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS`.
docs-bot: CI check queued for PR #9876. dependency: snippet-lint, linkcheck.
deploy-bot: FYI staged deploy of docs site at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/changes/9876 (expires in 48h). :rocket:
olivia: QA request — can we include a tiny diagram (ascii ok) showing request flow: client -> proxy1 -> eproxy -> kms -> hsm? saves a lot of words.
marie: added ascii diagram and a brief caption. done. tagging for final review. :raised_hands: 
chen: left two comments, both minor. once resolved, feel free to merge. :thumbsup:
tanay: approved.
olivia: approved.
marie: merging after i squash the docs-bot lint fix. thanks all! :shipit:
